title: RSD Suite
script:
local loadTypes = {1,2} --< Add/remove any number from the included scripts.

--[[
    --/ Roblox Script Development Suite [RSD]
    --\ Brought to you by @ivy.beach

    Included scripts:
        - None (0)
        - Infinite Yield (1)
        - Dex (2)
        - Remote Spy (3)
        - Internal Executor (4)
        - Audio Logger (5)
        - F3X Build Tools (6)
        - All (99) [This may cause a lag spike.]
]]

local scripts = {
    [1] = function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EdgeIY/infiniteyield/master/source"))()
    end,
    [2] = function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infyiff/backup/main/dex.lua"))()
    end,
    [3] = function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infyiff/backup/main/SimpleSpyV3/main.lua"))()
    end,
    [4] = function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infyiff/backup/refs/heads/main/executor.lua"))()
    end,
    [5] = function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infyiff/backup/main/audiologger.lua"), true)()
    end,
    [6] = function()
        loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infyiff/backup/refs/heads/main/f3x.lua"))()
    end
}

for _, v in ipairs(loadTypes) do
    if v == 99 then
        for _, func in pairs(scripts) do
            func()
        end
    elseif scripts[v] then
        scripts[v]()
    end
end
features:
An all-in-one script to help you create a cheat/script for any Roblox game.

Scripts within:
        - Infinite Yield
        - Dex
        - Remote Spy
        - Internal Executor
        - Audio Logger
        - F3X Build Tools
